pages.title: Made to Order
pages.text: Each bed belongs to one character and cannot be claimed twice. Stand one in a room of the matching house and that character takes it as hers. You cannot sleep in it, and it is not your respawn point either.

$(bold)What they do$()$(br)Right-clicking a bed does nothing at all — there is nothing to assign and nothing to check. Once a character has claimed one, she sleeps in it through the night, and if she dies a fresh copy of her lies in it again about ten minutes later.$(br2)$(bold)Where to put it$()$(br)A claimed bed has to stay in one of that house's rooms. Carry it out into the world and it is destroyed, so pick a real room and leave it there.
